atoms.text: The Giant’s Causeway is a natural wonder that can be found in Northern Ireland. The causeway is formed from many basalt columns. The causeway has been connected to folklore in the local area. Some stories suggest that it was created by a giant. Scientists have stated that the causeway formed as a result of volcanic activity.

atoms.a: Where can the Giant’s Causeway be found?
What type of rock is the Giant’s Causeway made of?

instruction.text: Read the following text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The Giant’s Causeway formed around 55 million years ago when lava oozed from the earth and cooled on the surface. The lava cooled in a unique way, forming about 40,000 hexagonal basalt columns of different sizes.

atoms.a: When did the Giant’s Causeway form?
